1.0: You're back! Let's see... you brought them all! Okay, it's show time now. Time to make history here, for this has never been made before. Now hold on one second... the screw goes here, the metal goes here, the battery goes here, and ...

yes.0: Tada! What do you think about the #b3 #t2100018#s#k? This sack will contain all kinds of toys that I made for this. They are a little on the wild side, though, so please be careful before opening up the sack. This was fun! I'll see you later!

item.0: Come on, hurry up! I'll make you a fun item if you bring #b20 #t4000112##k items from #o4230112# and #b30 #t4000115##k items from #o3230306#-type monsters.

0.0: Hi there. My name is #b#p2041018##k, and I work here at the Toy Factory as a member now. My job is to assemble toys in different ways to make the model work? You look a little bored, though... do you want to do something fun?

yes.0: Alright! I hope you didn't forget the fact that I'm the master toy assembler. We were forbidden from making any dangerous toys, so it had been quite boring for me. Please listen to me carefully as I will give you the list of items needed for something nice. Don't worry, it's for free.
yes.1: What you need are #b20 #t4000112##k items from #r#o4230112##k and #b30 #t4000115##k items from #r#o3230306##k-type monsters. Come back to me as soon as you find 'em. Look for #rMaster Robos#k near #b#m220030000##k and #rChronos#k around #b#m220040100##k. See ya soon!

no.0: Aww, you look bored though. Come on, you should try it! You won't be disappointed, that's for sure. So if you're ready to change your mind, then come talk to me.

QuestInfo.name: Assembling a Toy
QuestInfo.0: I should go see #p2041018# at Toy Factory.
QuestInfo.1: You met #bHans#k who's a toy assembler in the Ludibrium toy factory. Hans offered to make something fun if you give him materials to assemble a toy with. Sounds like fun! You need #b20 Mechanical Hearts#k from #rMaster Robos#k and #b30 Cogs#k from #rChronos#k. #rMaster Robos#k patrol around #b#m220030000##k and #rChronos#k are found near #b#m220040100##k.

He said he put some toys inside, but... I don't know, something may pop up that'll scare the daylight out of me. I better be careful with it...
